ai.title: Websocket error handling and client exit on failure
ai.summary: Websocket server refactored to pass through zod schema errors correctly. Client now rejects transactions on close instead of resolving, and exits with a message to get latest version on send errors. Covers backend server and common client.

eli5.text: When the app loses connection to the server, it now quietly closes any pending actions instead of throwing an error, letting the app try to reconnect and continue working. If you try to send new information while it's disconnected and that fails, you'll see an error message asking you to get the latest version rather than silently swallowing the problem. These changes are live and affect anyone using the real-time features of the app across both the server and client components.

ai.title: Add quick-build script for npm-app start
ai.summary: Added `quick-build` script to `npm-app/package.json` running only `tsc` and `tsc-alias`. Modified `start` and `start-js` scripts to invoke `quick-build` and `build` respectively before execution, skipping full monorepo dependency rebuilds during local development. This change affects only the `npm-app` package scripts.

eli5.text: Starting the local development server now runs a faster setup step that skips rebuilding every shared library in the project, so you only wait while the main app compiles its own code. The two commands used to launch the app locally were updated to call this lighter setup first, leaving the full rebuild path available for official builds. This affects only local development workflows for the npm-app package.
